message.content: {"evidence": "Hypothesis P1 (J1–J2) removes the N-component discontinuity at J2 but leaves a clear jump at J2 in E and U; P2 (J1–J3) leaves a residual jump at J2 in N and introduces a new discontinuity at J3 in N; only P3 (J2–J3) eliminates both the N and E jumps at J3 while preserving smooth motion across J2, matching the requirement that a true temporary offset must remove both boundary discontinuities without introducing new ones.", "pair_ids": ["P3"]}
